title: 'Moving moment' as Artemis II crew flies farther than humans have ever gone before
summary: The four astronauts of NASA's Artemis II mission flew deeper into space on Monday than any humans before them, as they cruised through a rare flyby of the shadowed far side of the moon that revealed a lunar surface under cosmic bombardment.
